initialPrompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: final production app icon and browser favicon for CODE:FIT, a Korean consumer learning service where beginners and developers learn to understand software, reason about AI-written code, and practice solving problems.
Primary request: Create ONE exceptionally simple, distinctive, friendly geometric brand symbol, not a presentation sheet. Concept: "understanding clicks into place". A bold, softly squared C-shaped loop with ONE separate small rounded square nestled toward its upper-right opening, like the final unit of understanding fitting into place. The C and the square together form a balanced, ownable silhouette, subtly nodding to code and fit without literal code brackets. Only TWO solid filled shapes. Broad strokes, generous inner negative space, clear gap between the square and the C. Geometry should be confident, slightly playful, exceptionally clean and readable at 16px. C is recognizable, block neither resembles a notification badge nor a speech bubble. Squared curves, not a circular power button.
Style/medium: pristine flat vector-like graphic, precise smooth edges. No 3D, gradients, glow, shadows, texture, outlines, thin lines, mascots, faces, sparkles, dumbbells, arrows, ticks, letters besides the abstract C, wordmark, text or watermark. Do not imitate any existing brand.
Color palette: symbol and separate square both solid light periwinkle #B4A3FF, on completely uniform deep charcoal #101218.
Composition: 1024x1024 square canvas, full-bleed charcoal background, no drawn container or rounded outer app tile. Single centered symbol occupies about 72% of canvas width and height, with clean equal safe margins. All details visible with substantial thickness; render a production asset, not a mockup.
refinementPrompt: Edit this logo into a clean final production asset. Preserve the concept and basic geometry: a thick softly squared C plus a detached rounded square at the upper right, both light periwinkle. Remove every white outline, colored speck, ragged edge, texture, noise and gradient. Use EXACTLY two uniform solid colors: flat #B4A3FF for both shapes, flat opaque #101218 for the entire background and negative space. No transparency anywhere, alpha fully opaque across the entire square canvas. Edges must be pristine antialiased vector-quality edges, absolutely no halos. Widen the horizontal gap between the top of C and the detached square to about 7% of total canvas width, by shortening the upper arm of the C, keep lower arm and detached square otherwise intact. Keep the mark optically centered with ~16% safe margin, strong negative space and bold strokes suitable for a 16px favicon. One 1024x1024 icon only, no text, no mockup, no presentation.
